name: Round for six: ROSENTORP in the open corner, the BESTÅ tower in the far corner
notes:
The top side is open to the living room (Andrew, 2026-10-24) as well as the left side to the kitchen, so both 30-inch walkways stay clear (F-42): every floor piece stands at x 30 or more and y 30 or more, nothing hangs on either open side, and rugs run under the walkways.
Round for six: the ROSENTORP round extendable in white, the no-corners option for a 4-year-old. Closed it seats four, the everyday table: three VIHALS (kitchen side, living-room side, right side) and Maddie's URBAN on the wall side. With the butterfly leaf in, it is a 61 x 43 1/4" oval across the room and seats six with the two stacked VIHALS from the extras.
F-36, closed: 48.5" to the kitchen line and 48.5" to the living-room line (passing sides), 36.25" to the right wall, 27.25" to the bottom wall (tight:27.3, Maddie's side: a parent pushes the URBAN in), and 26.8" on the diagonal to the BESTÅ tower (tight:26.8). Leaf in, the oval grows 8.9" each way along the room's width: 27.4" from its right end to the wall (tight:27.4), so with the leaf in seat three a side along the oval and leave its ends empty (the outer chairs sit at the curve, their backs at y 30): no chair stands in the kitchen walkway (F-42), and the ends stay 9.6" from the walkway and 27.4" from the wall.
The tower stands in the far corner, away from both openings, so it walls off no view; its doors open toward the table. During a meal it is reached past the right chair (17.75" between that chair and the wall, walkway-narrow:17.8); with the chairs pushed in under the round it is an easy step.
Final audit 2026-10-26: the weakest of the five: the 79" rug can't hold four chairs around the round (their back legs stand 5/8" off it), the leaf-in seating is three a side with the ends empty, the 17 3/4" shade is small for the round (the 27 1/2" GULLSUDARE would suit it), and the tower is reached past the right chair through 17.75". Hinge the tower's doors on the bottom-wall side so they open back against the wall; the art ends 1 5/8" from the tower. The HAVSRIS cord is 15' 5" (185"): with the ceiling unmeasured, check for a ceiling box first, and measure the ceiling and find the bottom wall's outlets before buying it (its drop and run need about 171" at a 96" ceiling and about 195" at 108", F-23).

placements.note: ROSENTORP round, closed, center (70.1, 70.1); F-36: 48.5" to both open sides, 36.25" to the right wall, 27.25" to the bottom wall (tight:27.3), 26.8" to the tower on the diagonal (tight:26.8); leaf in, a 61" oval across the room, 27.4" from its right end to the wall (tight:27.4)
kitchen side (west); its back on the walkway's edge (x 30)
right side (east); 17.75" behind it to the wall
living-room side (north); its back on the walkway's edge (y 30)
Maddie's URBAN on the wall side (south); 8.4" behind it (the tight side: a parent pushes her in)
BESTÅ shelf unit with doors, 76", in the bottom-right corner, the far corner from both openings; doors open toward the table; anchor it (F-21)
BLODFLÄDER on the right wall, centered on the table, above the east chair
VARPTROSS on the bottom wall behind Maddie's seat, center about 58" up, plug-in
GULLSUDARE 17 3/4" on the HAVSRIS swag cord over the table's center (small for a 43 1/4" round, 41% of it; the 27 1/2" GULLSUDARE its page offers would suit it, its page unread)
FEJKA bird of paradise in the bottom-left corner, against the bottom wall where the kitchen side opens: it closes the corner without standing in the kitchen walkway

LYDERSHOLM along the depth, centered on the round: 48" past it on the living-room side (30" of that under the walkway, F-42 allows rugs), 26.75" on the wall side, 17.9" east and west: even tucked in, the west and east chairs' back legs stand 5/8" off it (a 79" rug can't hold four chairs around a 43 1/4" round, which needs a 92 to 96" round rug centered on the table; none in the catalog, final audit 2026-10-26); 1.9" short of the tower

extras.note: two more VIHALS chairs, the fifth and sixth seats for the leaf-in six; stacked away (VIHALS stacks up to 6) until the leaf goes in
HAVSRIS cord set for the pendant: a ceiling hook over the table's center, the 15'5" cord along the ceiling to an outlet (the ceiling box is unknown); E26 LED bulb not in the catalog
STOPP FILT anti-slip underlays under the LYDERSHOLM (its page: 'You will need 2 ... Trim if necessary'): on tile with a 4-year-old running, the rug must not slide
SVARTSENAP runner, natural cotton, machine washable
SVARTSENAP placemats, one per seat, machine washable (online minimum 4)
BLANDA MATT 11" bamboo bowl, the centerpiece (fruit), unbreakable
MALINDA chair pads, one per VIHALS chair (5), light beige cotton, the whole pad machine washable
